questions: Do you also have tremor when your hands are completely relaxed and supported?
Does the tremor occur during activities such as writing, drinking, eating, or using tools?
Is the tremor present in both hands to a similar degree?
Do you have tremor of your head, voice, or legs?
Does alcohol noticeably reduce the tremor?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor?
Have you recently started or increased any medication, inhaler, stimulant, or supplement?
Do you regularly consume substantial amounts of caffeine or other stimulants?
Have you recently stopped drinking alcohol or taking a sedative medication?
Do you have slowness, stiffness, reduced arm swing, balance problems, or smaller handwriting?
Do you have weakness, numbness, difficulty speaking, double vision, or problems with coordination?
Have you had unexplained weight loss, heat intolerance, sweating, palpitations, or frequent loose stools?
Is the tremor markedly worse when you are anxious, tired, or sleep-deprived?
Do you have abnormal sustained postures or involuntary movements elsewhere in your body?
